item.text: I’m checking the current source tree and status first so I can make a real follow-up refactor rather than repeating the last implementation cleanup.

I’m adding a small parser/formatter split for the demo path so the CLI concerns stop living alongside the algorithm. That gives the codebase a cleaner separation without changing the core prefix-sum API.
I’m wiring the demo through the new parser and formatter next so the entry point becomes a thin shell over the reusable utilities.
I’m extending the tests for the new parser and formatter seams. That keeps the refactor honest and ensures the demo path doesn’t become an untested edge.
The refactor is in place. I’m compiling the full source tree and then running the tests plus both demo modes to make sure the new parser/formatter path behaves cleanly.
I’ve got the new files in the tree. I’m building to a temp directory next, then I’ll run the test harness and the demo with and without CLI arguments.
Compilation passed. I’m running the test harness and both demo modes now: the default sample path and a CLI-argument path to verify the parser.
